headline: Blue Star shares drop despite Q2 earnings beat
summary: Blue Star reported Q2 revenue and operating profit that exceeded consensus estimates. Despite the strong top-line performance, rising material costs negatively impacted profit margins. winners_losers: UBS gains / Blue Star shareholders hurt

headline: Blue Star reports Q2 profit up 26% to Rs 124 crore on strong revenue growth
hook: Strong revenue growth beats street estimates
summary: Blue Star reported a 26% increase in net profit to Rs 124 crore for the quarter ended September, driven by a 21% rise in revenue to Rs 2,931 crore. Both revenue and profit numbers came in above poll estimates. However, higher material costs put pressure on the company's operating margins during the period. Indian retail investors tracking consumer durables and engineering stocks will note the strong demand momentum despite margin headwinds.

why_it_matters: Strong demand lifts Blue Star shares despite cost pressures.

headline: Blue Star reports 21 percent rise in Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue
hook: Strong revenue growth offset by margin compression
summary: Blue Star Limited announced its financial results for the second quarter of fiscal year 2027, posting a consolidated revenue of Rs 2930.95 crores, marking a 21 percent year-on-year increase. Operating profit for the quarter grew by 10.5 percent to reach Rs 202.58 crores. The performance reflects steady demand in its core segments despite relative pressure on operating margins. Retail investors holding Blue Star shares can assess the demand trajectory in the cooling and commercial air conditioning market.
